# FS-group: Group

Typo inside the group's own path: §group/alph/FS-alpha. The valid spelling is §group/alpha/FS-alpha.
Shorter top-level alias: §alpha/FS-alpha.
Equal alias path: §group/FS-group.
Genuinely outside the narrowed scope: §outside/alpha/FS-alpha.
Lexical prefix only: §grouped/alpha/FS-alpha.
This is the group document: §FS-group.
